description: Laney p′ control limits (center, lower, upper, sigmaZ, as proportions) for a unit with nI valid attempts, from the baseline units' (k, n) in time order. Read by chat-consistency-charts.spec.ts against ccLaneyPPrimeLimits, which draws the availability chart's limits, and by Overseer.Tests ChatConsistencyClientParityTests against ChatConsistencyStatistics.LaneyPPrimeLimits, the server's reference implementation; both must return these values within the tolerance. An expected of null means no limits.

cases.name: unequal n with both limits inside
unequal n with the lower limit clipped
zero-attempt unit skipped in the moving range
one unit is the plain p chart
sigmaZ of zero from equal proportions

divergent.name: nI of zero
divergent.reason: The server throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a non-positive nI; the client returns null, because the chart has no limits to draw for a unit without valid attempts.

excluded.name: k above n
excluded.reason: The server throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException; the client does not validate counts, and the chart never passes a unit with more provider errors than valid attempts.

excluded.name: negative count
excluded.reason: The server throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException; the client does not validate counts, and the chart never passes a negative count.
